user.title: Add an RTSPX camera
user.description: Add one camera. Repeat this flow for each camera. The stream URL is stored in Home Assistant and is masked in this form and diagnostics.

data_description.unique_id: A stable lowercase ID such as patio_camera. Keep the same ID when migrating an existing camera.
data_description.stream_source: The full rtspx:// URL. Remove the enableSrtp query option before saving.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure camera
reconfigure.description: Update the display name or protected RTSPX URL. The stable Camera ID cannot be changed here.

error.invalid_rtspx_url: Enter a complete rtspx:// URL with a host and stream path.
error.enable_srtp_not_allowed: Remove the enableSrtp query option; Home Assistant's native go2rtc path does not use it.

abort.already_configured: A camera with this Camera ID is already configured.
